title: Virtual-Alloy Physics-Aware Semantic System for extrapolative prediction of perovskite solar cells
abstract: arXiv:2610.18949v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing machine-learning models for perovskite solar cells struggle to predict devices made from new materials. Most treat device layers as arbitrary categorical labels and represent perovskite absorbers either through featureless composition vectors or through rigid crystal graphs that require a pre-solved unit cell. As a result, they cannot generalize to unrecorded alloys or unfamiliar cell architectures. We present the Virtual-Alloy Physics-Aware Semantic System (V-PaSS), an architecture built around the physical continuity of perovskite solid solutions. V-PaSS represents arbitrary mixed-cation, mixed-halide absorbers by interpolating relaxed crystal graphs of 23 pure $ABX_3$ endpoint compounds via Vegard's law with learned bandgap bowing. translated_title: 面向钙钛矿太阳能电池外推预测的虚拟合金物理感知语义系统
translated_abstract: 现有的钙钛矿太阳能电池机器学习模型难以预测由新材料制成的器件。大多数模型将器件层视为任意的分类标签，并通过无特征的成分向量或需要预先求解晶胞的刚性晶体图来表示钙钛矿吸光层。因此，它们无法泛化到未经记录的合金或不熟悉的电池结构。我们提出了虚拟合金物理感知语义系统（V-PaSS），这是一种围绕钙钛矿固溶体物理连续性构建的架构。V-PaSS通过维加德定律并结合学习到的带隙弯曲效应，对23种纯ABX₃端元化合物的弛豫晶体图进行插值，从而表示任意混合阳离子、混合卤素的吸光层。对于器件叠层，它将层序与电池极性（n-i-p或p-i-n）同界面能带偏移相耦合，并利用科学语言模型对化学描述进行编码。在评估中……
tldr: 该研究提出V-PaSS系统，通过维加德定律插值端元化合物晶体图并结合界面能带偏移与科学语言模型，实现了对新型材料钙钛矿太阳能电池的外推性能预测。
en_tdlr: V-PaSS represents arbitrary mixed-cation/mixed-halide perovskite absorbers by interpolating crystal graphs of endpoint compounds via Vegard's law with learned bandgap bowing, enabling extrapolative prediction of perovskite solar cells built from new materials.
